# Alibaba.com

> > Global B2B marketplace connecting buyers with manufacturers and suppliers across industries, featuring verified suppliers like LED lighting manufacturers from China's Guangdong province.

Alibaba.com is the world's largest online B2B trading platform, showcasing millions of products from suppliers worldwide. The platform specializes in connecting international buyers with Chinese manufacturers and exporters across categories including electronics, lighting, machinery, textiles, and consumer goods.
